metadata.title: Eurasian Fight Circuit - Male Regional Name Database
metadata.usage_note: Pools are designed for believable game generation. Overlap between neighbouring Muslim and post-Soviet regions is intentional. Surnames use male forms. The first 100 entries retain the original core pools; ranks 101-200 expand them with less-common regional names, transliteration variants, and realistic patronymic-style surnames rather than a strict census ranking.
